name: steps-s3-copy
description: The root package of a mono repo for Steps S3 copy

scripts.dev-deploy: bun run build && cd dev && bun install && bunx cdk deploy
scripts.dev-destroy: bun run build && cd dev && bun install && bunx cdk destroy
scripts.dev-synth: bun run build && cd dev && bun install && bunx cdk synth
scripts.postinstall: bun run install:steps-s3-copy && bun run install:dev && bun run install:dev-testsuite

author.name: University of Melbourne Centre for Cancer Research
